name: Belarus

system.type: Direct presidential vote with an "against all" option

wildFacts.text: Officially, more voters chose "against all" than voted for any challenger.
It was the third election since 2020 that OSCE/ODIHR could not observe, as it was not invited in time.

notes: All figures are officially reported by the Central Election Commission, via the state outlet SB.by: 5,916,195 of 6,903,994 registered voters took part (85.69% turnout), and 2,887,052 voted early (41.8% of registered voters). The commission's own site (rec.gov.by) could not be reached. A UK and German statement calling the election pre-determined was not checked, so it is omitted.
